title: The Missed Customer
look: Photorealistic, Scandinavian, cinematic. Cool winter daylight for the problem, warm gold practicals for the solution. Shallow depth of field, 35–50 mm feel, gentle handheld that settles into locked-off calm.
hook: Kuinka moni asiakas jäi tänään ilman vastausta?
How many customers went unanswered today?
كم عميلاً بقي اليوم بلا رد؟
honest: The solution is shown as a clear digital workflow, not as a named product. No response-time, conversion or revenue figures. UI screens carry a 'concept visual' label.

scenes.name: Overwhelmed
scenes.action: A Finnish small-business owner (40s, apron or work shirt) stands at a light birch counter. A landline rings, a phone buzzes across the counter, a laptop shows a growing inbox. She reaches for one, then the other.
scenes.cam: Medium shot, slow handheld push-in, 35 mm. Rack focus from buzzing phone to her face.
scenes.light: Soft overcast window light, desaturated blue-grey; phone screens are the only warm points.
scenes.sound: Overlapping ringtone, vibration on wood, notification pings building in rhythm. Low uneasy pad.
scenes.text: Hook, centre, large serif: FI/EN/AR as above.
scenes.mg: Seven notification cards drop and shake, blur back, hook rises word by word.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic photorealistic shot, small Finnish shop counter in soft winter daylight, a business owner in her 40s overwhelmed as a phone buzzes on the birch counter and a laptop fills with emails, slow handheld push-in, shallow depth of field, muted Scandinavian palette, phone screens blurred and unreadable, no text, no logos

title: The AI Employee

hook: Entä jos asiakaspalvelusi voisi auttaa myös työajan jälkeen?
